Market today: Tech and chip names are facing headwinds today, primarily driven by post-earnings slides from key players like Apple and Palantir. Broader market sentiment is also cautious with global rate hike concerns. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Several leveraged positions are in deep drawdowns and need attention. SOXL (-69.67%), MUU (-42.78%), and SPAL (-46.88%) are particularly concerning given their amplified nature and your margin usage. PLTU (-13.61%) is also very close to its stop.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the broader tech indices (QQQ, SMH) react to continued earnings news and any further shifts in interest rate expectations. Pay special attention to your leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Risk management is paramount; respect your stops, especially on leveraged positions, to protect your capital.
plays: Consider trimming PLTU if it breaks its 49 stop, given Palantir's post-earnings slide.
Watch QQQ closely around its 670 stop. A break could signal further weakness in the broader tech market.
Review stops on SOXL, MUU, and SPAL. Their deep drawdowns and leveraged nature demand a clear exit strategy.
